questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] Do identical twins have identical fingerprints?
A. Yes
B. No
C. Only some of their fingers are identical while other fingers can be different
Answer: B. Despite having identical DNA, identical twins have unique fingerprints. The formation of fingerprints is influenced by both genetic and environmental factors during fetal development, resulting in distinct ridge patterns for each individual, even in identical twins.
questions.de: Welches körperliche Erkennungsmerkmal unterscheidet sich selbst bei eineiigen Zwillingen trotz identischer DNA, weil sein Linienmuster im Mutterleib auch durch Umwelteinflüsse entsteht?
questions.en: Which physical identifying feature differs even between identical twins despite their identical DNA, because its ridge pattern forms in the womb under environmental influences as well?

timeline.labelEn: Francis Galton publishes 'Finger Prints', a statistical case that no two people share the same fingerprints
timeline.labelDe: Francis Galton veröffentlicht „Finger Prints“, einen statistischen Nachweis, dass keine zwei Menschen dieselben Fingerabdrücke haben

questions.notes: Yes/no card reworked to ask the feature. Identical twins' fingerprint patterns are very similar but not identical; ridges form around the 13th–15th week of fetal development.

questions.cardText:
[Botany] What kind of trees are deciduous trees?
A. They stay green year-round
B. They shed leaves annually
C. They only grow in a Mediterranean climate
Answer: B.
questions.de: Was tun laubabwerfende (sommergrüne) Bäume jedes Jahr, im Gegensatz zu immergrünen Bäumen?
questions.en: What do deciduous trees do every year, unlike evergreen trees?

timeline.labelEn: Glossopteris, among the earliest trees thought to be deciduous, forms forests in the Permian
timeline.labelDe: Glossopteris, einer der frühesten vermutlich laubabwerfenden Bäume, bildet im Perm Wälder

questions.notes: Timeline: Glossopteris is assumed deciduous from its fossil autumnal leaf banks (Wikipedia 'Glossopteris'); the term itself has no datable origin on the pages checked.
